c_linear_attribution.checks: ecosystem-lookup-check direct exit 0: 96 timed and 96 account cases plus seven fault refusals; account direct exit 0, all final live zero
limitations: C attribution control is not an ordinary Rust/C++ peer.
Although cell extents match WF, C has a 16-byte allocation header and differing invalid-tag handling.
c_linear_attribution.native: C query 191 instructions/16-byte frame both widths, no calls, unconditional initial modulo, running-index probe, 24/272-byte enum cells and extra 16-byte allocation header; C lacks WF invalid-tag abort branch
c_linear_attribution.purpose: same enum-cell stride and bounded running-index lookup lower-level control; excluded from ordinary Rust/C++ performance target

lookup_check.base: timed 72/72 and account 72/72, direct exit 0; six fault controls direct expected exit 1, Make target exit 0

validation_only_fault_repair.result: direct 0, 72 timed + 72 account and six shared-path fault refusals; no timed panel replay because measured images remain pinned

collated_samples.line_ending: LF; values and row order retained from all raw CSVs

enum_domain_paired.compiler_validation: Final 11 focused resource/payload enum tests direct pass; optimized CLI build direct 0, reported 44.17 s. Full make check not run on this uncommitted compiler change.
limitations: Only 64-slot misses improve in every same-seed sample in both cohorts; hit ranges overlap.
4096 miss timings include cohort/seed variation and do not establish a uniform large gain.
The candidate does not meet the overall slower-Rust/C++ target across lookup cells.
enum_domain_paired.native: Raw LLVM abort calls 219->1 in the whole emitted module; selected vacant exit drops invalid-tag cbnz/cold abort, frames remain 16 bytes, no new hot calls/spills; static query instruction count 235->237 due duplicated final digest/return. Six C/Rust/C++ linked query bodies byte/address identical.

executed_commands.formal: perl .github/run-check.pl map-lookup-{arm}-{cohort} sh -c "<arm-map-timed> lookup-measure <cohort> 2097152 > <raw-csv>"; exact arm/cohort/guard labels and raw paths are in raw_sources and retained guard logs.

limitations: Rust standard HashMap exposes usable capacity 56/3584, not physical slot count; 64/4096 physical slots are inferred from this implementation and allocation extents, not a public capacity API.
C++ std::unordered_map reports 64/4096 chaining buckets and allocates nodes; equal bucket counts are not equal element-slot representation or memory bytes.
Mask widened reached query frame 16 to 32 bytes and 235 to 287 instructions despite removing selected power-of-two division; generic fallback retained.
First pilot CSV includes guard banner lines; collated CSV filters only child header/data, raw scratch pilot remains pinned.

native_costs.method: otool -tvV on pinned O3 objects; count instruction-address lines in each exported query instance through the next symbol
native_costs.observed_selected_path: running-index saved 9 instructions and 16 bytes of frame against base; mask removes power-of-two division but increases query body by 52 instructions and frame by 16 bytes against index. No general no-call claim beyond the inspected path.

protocol.query_result: ordered digest of hit flag then borrowed first value word on hit
protocol.timer: CLOCK_MONOTONIC around one in-language rounds-by-count query batch; setup/geometry/cleanup outside

purpose: Query-only ordinary-library HashMap hit/miss comparison on half-full backings; retire these records when this experiment is superseded.

source_after_timing.note: Only ECO_LOOKUP_WORK default route changed to the already used formal work 2097152; no timed image rebuilt after this edit.
